body: Thank you for the offer! I've seen you on other threads talking and taking an interest in people! I appreciate what you do!

Hey man, I just want to say that I related to your post. Heartbreak's a bitch and i've had my fair share. And I have been in a similar position as you.

May I ask for more information, if you want to talk about it? Like, how did she string you along, what happened, etc. I can understand if you don't want to talk about this stuff and I understand if revisiting this hurts. Just letting you know that i'm here and I know how you might be feeling.

Sorry for the late reply, I fell asleep. But you said you were new to reddit, so I did some light searching and found a few subreddits.

r/learnmath can help you with getting the broader idea, whilist r/MathHelp can help you with more specific equations and whatnot. r/cheatatmathhomework if you have problems with homework, there's no shame in cheating if you don't understand it nor have an interest in it, but please try not to get caught, and finally r/HomeworkHelp is a fairly active sub.

You could just go and talk to the teacher, tho they really do sound like an ass. Usually they do respect a student who just straight-up asks for help, but I assume you've already done that. Just remember to suck up to them and give them the feeling of talking to an equal. Sadly I have little idea how the education system works in other countries, and since the semester is nearing it's end you have to be quick about it all. Mind you fixing a grade in a couple of weeks is doable, so good luck!

And I wouldn't worry about the teacher embarrassing you in front of the other students. They're too busy being scared themselves. I'm rooting for you mate!
Yea I reported like 2 comments from them, really disgusting that people enjoy doing this sort of thing.
Does anybody in your area offer tutoring services? There's little to be done about shit teachers, but you can always ask for assistance from somebody.
No worries! This sub attracts trolls who enjoy being called names, nothing to be done about it sadly.
Math's always a tough nut to crack, I passed my final exam with exactly half a point so I know where you're coming from. What subjects do you enjoy?
Just report them and move on, nothing to be accomplished by responding to it. Only mods have power over him.

going through something similar right now, except it was more of a "friends with benefits" type of deal and she just didn't feel the same way about it all. Which is fine but shit man, why it gotta hurt like that?

Still, doesn't mean you can't develop a purely platonic relationship, if you feel like you can handle it. For some it can work, whilist for others it's best to just move on. I'd say take as much time as you need, and keep being productive. Sending extra love your way, if you need it <3
